service-call.name: org.moqui.admin.OperationServices.find#Messages

actions.script: ec.message.clearErrors() const colors = {failed: 'negative', retrying: 'warning', uncertain: 'deep-orange', inProgress: 'info', waiting: 'info', done: 'positive', staged: 'grey-7', rejected: 'grey-7', cancelled: 'grey-7'} const when = value => value ? ec.l10n.format(Date.parse(value), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') : '' // the owner's own place for a message, by the key its registration names (never a URL from data) const ownerRoutes = {storeIntegration: row => '/qapps/Commerce/Integrations/IntegrationDetail?systemMessageRemoteId=' + encodeURIComponent(row.ownerRef) + '&systemMessageId=' + encodeURIComponent(row.systemMessageId)} messages = Array.from(found?.messageList || []).map(row => Object.assign({}, row, { stateColor: colors[row.state] || 'grey-7', routeText: [row.typeText, row.remoteText].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') + (row.remoteDisabled ? ' (remote disabled)' : ''), timeText: when(row.initDate), attemptText: row.failCount ? row.failCount + ' failed' + (row.lastAttemptDate ? ', last ' + when(row.lastAttemptDate) : '') : '', referenceText: [row.messageId, row.remoteMessageId && row.remoteMessageId !== row.messageId ? row.remoteMessageId : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' · '), problemText: [row.errorClass, row.errorText].filter(Boolean).join(': '), ownerUrl: row.ownerRef && Object.hasOwn(ownerRoutes, row.ownerRoute || '') ? ownerRoutes[row.ownerRoute](row) : '', ownerText: [row.ownerApp, row.ownerStateText].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') || 'Not registered'})) messagesCount = Number(found?.messageCount || 0) messagesPageIndex = Number(found?.pageIndex || 0) messagesPageSize = Number(found?.pageSize || 50) messagesPageMaxIndex = Math.max(Math.ceil(messagesCount / messagesPageSize) - 1, 0) messagesPageRangeLow = messagesCount ? messagesPageIndex * messagesPageSize + 1 : 0 messagesPageRangeHigh = Math.min((messagesPageIndex + 1) * messagesPageSize, messagesCount) stateOptions = Array.from(found?.stateList || []).map(row => ({value: row.state, label: row.text})) typeOptions = Array.from(found?.typeList || []).map(row => ({value: row.systemMessageTypeId, label: row.description})) findValues = {state: state || 'attention', systemMessageTypeId: systemMessageTypeId, direction: direction, reference: reference, fromDate: fromDate, thruDate: thruDate, systemMessageRemoteId: systemMessageRemoteId} const filters = {state: state, systemMessageTypeId: systemMessageTypeId, systemMessageRemoteId: systemMessageRemoteId, direction: direction, reference: reference, fromDate: fromDate, thruDate: thruDate, pageIndex: pageIndex} filterJson = JSON.stringify(filters) // bulk recovery: what of this page may be chosen, by the action bulkActions = [{value: 'retry', label: 'Retry now', flag: 'retryEligible'}, {value: 'requeue', label: 'Queue again', flag: 'requeueEligible'}, {value: 'cancel', label: 'Cancel', flag: 'cancelEligible'}] bulkChoices = messages.filter(row => bulkActions.some(option => row[option.flag])).map(row => ({value: row.systemMessageId, label: row.systemMessageId + ' · ' + row.routeText + ' · ' + row.stateText + ' (' + bulkActions.filter(option => row[option.flag]).map(option => option.label.toLowerCase()).join(', ') + ')'})) bulkValues = Object.assign({}, filters, {bulkAction: 'retry'}) // what was chosen for a review, as ids (a check field posts a list, a link one text) bulkChosen = (Array.isArray(bulkIds) ? bulkIds : String(bulkIds || '').split(',')).map(id => String(id).trim()).filter(Boolean) reviewing = available && bulkChosen.length > 0 && !!bulkAction

label.text: What became of the messages this instance sends to and receives from other systems: what failed, what is tried again, and what may or may not have gone through. A message's content is not shown here.
System messages are not available to you.

link.parameter-map: {state:state, systemMessageTypeId:systemMessageTypeId, systemMessageRemoteId:systemMessageRemoteId, direction:direction, reference:reference, fromDate:fromDate, thruDate:thruDate, pageIndex:pageIndex}

label.text: Each message is taken on its own: one that is refused or fails is named in the result and the others go on. A message whose outcome is unknown is never retried here.

default-field.tooltip: Kept in the audit log beside each message
